problem: Raw TAR files were rejected or metadata-only; native empty hard-link targets were silently presented as regular empty files.
rootCause: No TAR entry dispatch, extraction or header-link resolver. Native TarHandler omits empty Hard Link values; typed Characteristics property preserves the raw hard-link flag.
fix: Explicit raw TAR route, native-index bounded body extraction, package symbolic/directory links and preceding-member hard links. Native listing API3 distinguishes empty hard-link targets; devices/FIFO explicitly unavailable.
